questions.ask: What is your date of birth?
What are the last four digits of the phone number we have on file for you?

hints.day_month_swapped: Could you please say your date of birth again, with the month as a word?

intents.hardship: The customer mentions illness, a death in the family or job loss.
intents.dispute: "This debt is not mine" or "I never had this product"; a claim that the product was closed or paid off in the past is also a dispute.
intents.already_paid: "I already paid": only a payment of this past-due amount; a claim that the product was closed or paid off in the past is a dispute instead.
intents.restructure: A request for a new payment plan or lower instalments.
intents.vague: A vague period such as "next week", "end of the month" or "when my salary comes".
intents.too_much: The customer says the full past-due amount is too much.
intents.human: The customer asks for a human.

lines.opening: Hello, I am a digital assistant calling from Freya Bank, and we record this call.
lines.robot: I am Freya Bank's digital assistant.
lines.scam: You can verify this call by phoning Freya Bank's customer service number.
lines.purpose_before_verify: I can only discuss the reason for my call with {title} {last_name}, once I have confirmed who I am speaking with.
lines.no_info: I am sorry, I do not have that information.
lines.not_talk_once: I understand. This will only take a moment.
lines.tp_ask: When would be a good time to reach {title} {last_name}?
lines.tp_ask_time: At what time could we call back?
lines.tp_outside_window: I am sorry, we can only call back today or on the next business day, between 10 am and 7 pm. Could you suggest another time?
lines.tp_no_info: I am sorry, I can only speak with {title} {last_name} directly.
lines.tp_booked: Thank you. We will call back on {date} at {time}.
lines.wrong_number: I am sorry for the trouble. Thank you for letting me know.
lines.condolence: I am sorry for your loss.
lines.id_intro: Before we continue, I need to ask you two security questions.
lines.id_explain: I ask these questions to protect your account and to make sure I am speaking only with you.
lines.id_declined: I understand. Without these answers I cannot continue this call.
lines.id_repeat: Sorry, could you please repeat that?
lines.id_wrong: I am sorry, that does not match our records.
lines.id_failed: I am sorry, I could not verify your identity. Please use the Freya Bank mobile app or visit a branch.
lines.disclose_intro: Thank you. I am calling from the collections team about a late payment.
lines.product_line: Your {name} has {amount} past due and is {days} days late.
lines.ask_today: Can you make this payment today?
lines.ask_today_multi: Can you make all of these payments today?
lines.offer_floor_date: I understand. The rest would stay overdue, but could you pay {amount} on {date}?
lines.offer_floor: I understand. The rest would stay overdue, but could you pay {amount}?
lines.below_floor: I am sorry, I cannot record an amount below {floor}. Could you pay {floor} instead?
lines.below_floor_again: I am sorry, I cannot record that amount.
lines.date_past: I am sorry, the date must be today or later. Which day from today would work for you?
lines.not_business_day: That day is not a business day. The next business day is {date}. Would that work for you?
lines.after_deadline: The latest date I can record is {date}. Could you pay by then?
lines.vague_ask: Which exact day would that be?
lines.ask_date_for_amount: On which day could you pay {amount}?
lines.readback_intro: Let me read that back to you.
lines.clamped_note: For your {name}, the latest date I can record is {deadline}, so I will use that date.
lines.recorded: Thank you, your promise is recorded.
lines.sms_line: You will receive a text message confirming this promise.
lines.record_failed: I am sorry, I could not record your promise.
lines.paid_line: Thank you for letting me know. Payments can take one business day to appear.
lines.dispute_line: I understand, and I will make a note of that.
lines.hardship: I am very sorry to hear that. Would you like me to connect you with our customer support team?
lines.restructure_line: I will connect you with a colleague who can discuss that with you.
lines.human_ask_help: I may be able to help you myself. Is there something I can help you with?
lines.transfer: I am transferring you now. Please hold.
lines.anything_else: Is there anything else I can help you with?
lines.promise_change: A promise cannot be changed or cancelled on this call, but you can change it in the mobile app.
lines.goodbye: Thank you for your time. Goodbye.
lines.callback_failed: I am sorry, I could not book the callback.
lines.transfer_failed: I am sorry, the transfer did not go through.
lines.confirm_again: Sorry, I did not catch that. Do you confirm, yes or no?
lines.system_error: I am sorry, our system is not responding right now.

assumptions: I was given both Brief A and Brief B. Brief B is the more specific, later document: it is Brief A plus rules for up to three products. So this spec follows Brief B, with Brief A's rules applying wherever Brief B does not replace them. It also works for one product, apart from add_note: Brief A never uses add_note, but Brief B requires it, so notes.enabled is true.
Brief B rule 10 overrides note events: on any transfer (restructuring, support or human), no add_note calls are made at all.

Brief B closing overrides Brief A for several products: if any promise is recorded, close as promise, unless there is a transfer. If no promise is recorded and every product is noted paid, close as paid. Otherwise, close as no_promise with the reason of the first product, in get_account order, whose note is not paid.
Brief B rule 11 overrides Brief A rule 37: if create_promise fails twice for one product, promises already recorded are kept, and that product gets an add_note with reason service_error.
The brief names no currency, so the default 'dollars' is used.

The callback window is today or the next business day, 10:00 to 19:00 inclusive, and later than now. The brief does not say whether a same-day callback must be on a business day, so business_days_only is false.
Rule 7 lets the agent ask once more after a time outside the window, so callback max_asks is 2.
Rule 3 allows two asks to confirm the customer, so confirm max_asks is 2.
Rule 15: asking what the call is about counts as declining. Other questions do not, so question_is_decline is false.
Rule 30, attempt 1: if today is the last business day of this week, the engine proposes the last business day of next week instead.
Deadlines are counted in business days, so they always fall on a business day. previous_business_day is kept only as a safeguard.
Floor names come from the field names: 'minimum payment' for credit cards and 'instalment amount' for loans.
The brief does not say whether to ask 'anything else' after a recorded promise, so the default (true) is used.
The brief says the call is recorded. It is phrased as 'we record this call' to keep the word 'recorded' out of the opening.
Response success flags use the 'ok' boolean, as described in the tool API file.
add_note 'text' is optional in the API and is not mapped. close_call 'reason' is sent only where the outcome table lists one.
